title: Chương 01: Nước Không Có Đáy
requiredFacts: Cao Minh and Lục Trầm enter this arc as the only living members of the travelling group.
Cao Minh still carries the dark cord passed from Hưng through Duy; no supernatural property of the cord is established.
forbiddenClaims: Do not revive Duy, Hưng, Nam or Khải.
Do not treat unknown movement or sound under the flooded hospital water as a confirmed Entity without evidence.
